metadata.name: AskATT System1 multiclass Choice benchmark
metadata.purpose: Test semantic multiclass Choice, shared-state multi-question evaluation, distractor handling, and option-order stability.

department.instructions: Which department should own the caller's primary request?

criteria.billing: Billing, charges, payments, refunds, credits, fees, or invoices
criteria.technical: Internet, mobile service, connectivity, device, activation, error, or performance troubleshooting
criteria.sales: New purchase, upgrade, plan recommendation, price quote, or adding service
criteria.cancellation: Cancel, disconnect, remove, retire, or terminate service or a line
criteria.smart_home: Home security, cameras, sensors, locks, alarms, or smart-home equipment

urgency.instructions: What is the operational urgency of the primary request?

criteria.routine: Informational or planned request with no outage, material impact, or time pressure
criteria.elevated: Service degradation, repeated inconvenience, or account impact while basic activity can continue
criteria.urgent: Service is blocked, work is materially affected, or same-day action is explicitly needed
criteria.critical: Safety risk, emergency condition, widespread outage, or severe business impact requiring immediate action

sentiment.instructions: What is the caller's expressed sentiment?

criteria.positive: Satisfied, appreciative, excited, pleased, or optimistic
criteria.neutral: Matter-of-fact, informational, or neither clearly pleased nor upset
criteria.negative: Frustrated, angry, disappointed, worried, or dissatisfied

next_action.instructions: What is the best immediate next action for the primary request?

criteria.explain_information: Answer a question or explain policy, timing, status, or account information without changing service
criteria.billing_review: Investigate or correct a charge, payment, refund, invoice, fee, or credit
criteria.troubleshoot: Perform remote troubleshooting, reset, diagnostics, configuration, or activation steps
criteria.schedule_technician: Arrange an onsite technician, field repair, or equipment replacement visit
criteria.process_service_change: Cancel, remove, disconnect, or otherwise change an existing service or line
criteria.sales_followup: Provide a quote, recommend a product, complete an upgrade, or add a new service

[Agent]: How can I help?
[Caller]: I am angry because an unfamiliar $49 charge appeared on my bill. Please investigate it and remove it.

[Agent]: What is happening with your service?
[Caller]: My internet is completely down and I cannot work. I need it restored today. Please walk me through troubleshooting now.

[Agent]: What can I do for you?
[Caller]: I am excited about the newest phone and would like an upgrade quote. There is no rush.

[Agent]: How may I assist?
[Caller]: Please remove one unused phone line at the end of this billing cycle. Everything else is fine.

[Agent]: Tell me about the problem.
[Caller]: My security camera is offline again. I am frustrated, but the alarm still works. Please help me reconnect it.

[Agent]: How can I help today?
[Caller]: I was promised a refund and it never arrived. This is disappointing and I need the credit reviewed.

[Agent]: Is anyone in danger?
[Caller]: A fallen tree tore down the fiber line outside our medical office. Phones and internet are out for the whole site. Send a field technician immediately.

[Agent]: What would you like to do?
[Caller]: I am happy with the service and want to add a new line for my daughter. Please show me the available plans.

[Agent]: How may I help?
[Caller]: I am unhappy with the repeated price increases. Disconnect all services before the next bill.

[Agent]: What is the smart-home issue?
[Caller]: The alarm keeps triggering falsely in the middle of the night and waking everyone. I am worried it may fail in a real emergency. Please send a technician today.

[Agent]: What billing information do you need?
[Caller]: Could you explain when my payment is due? I am not disputing anything and there is no hurry.

[Agent]: What error are you seeing?
[Caller]: The router shows error 204 and devices disconnect every hour. It is annoying, but I can still work. Please run diagnostics with me.

[Agent]: What brings you in today?
[Caller]: A debit landed on my account that I do not recognize. I am pretty upset and want someone to trace it.

[Agent]: Describe the issue.
[Caller]: Every page is a spinning wheel and throughput has collapsed. My video meetings are impossible, so I need a same-day fix.

[Agent]: What account change do you need?
[Caller]: I would like to retire the number ending in 4421 next month. This is a planned cleanup and I am not upset.

[Agent]: How can I help?
[Caller]: I am looking forward to trading in my old handset for the latest model. Please tell me the offers whenever convenient.

[Agent]: Is this about the bill?
[Caller]: The bill is correct and I do not need billing help. My problem is that the front-door camera will not connect, and I am frustrated. Please troubleshoot the camera.

[Agent]: Are you still calling about the outage?
[Caller]: No, the internet problem is resolved. I am pleased now and my only request is a quote to upgrade our phones.

[Agent]: Do you want a bill credit?
[Caller]: No credit and no billing review. I simply need one unused mobile line removed. It can happen at the normal cycle date.

[Agent]: Is your internet failing?
[Caller]: No, the internet works perfectly. I only want a neutral explanation of the activation fee on this invoice; I am not disputing it.

[Agent]: I see both a charge question and slow internet. Which matters most?
[Caller]: The charge can wait. I am angry because the connection is unusable and blocking work. Restore the service today; that is my primary request.

[Agent]: You mentioned an old line and a new phone. What should we do first?
[Caller]: First, I am excited to add a new upgraded phone and get a quote. We can remove the old line later. There is no rush.

[Agent]: Is the bill or alarm your priority?
[Caller]: The small fee is fine. The alarm sensor is offline and leaves the house unprotected. I am worried and need a technician today.

[Agent]: We applied the outage credit. What remains?
[Caller]: Thank you for the credit, but repeated outages have been disappointing. My primary request now is to cancel the service before another bill.
